final: WITH g AS (SELECT COALESCE(rfistat,'(no status)') AS status, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY COALESCE(rfistat,'(no status)')), o AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL), q AS (SELECT g.status, g.avg_mod, g.avg_mod - o.overall AS above_overall FROM g, o WHERE g.avg_mod > o.overall) SELECT status, avg_mod, above_overall, avg_mod - (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) FROM q) AS diff_from_qualifying_mean FROM q
